newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro awards Troll oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro awards Troll oil contract.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Tuesday it awarded a contract for the fabrication and installation of subsea lines for a group of wells on the Troll B oil development to a joint venture between Brown & Root Energy Services AS (Rockwater) and Wellstream Inc.
The contract was worth around 220 million crowns, a company statement said.
The subsea lines will be installed during the summer of 1997 with production start up planned for October 1, 1997.
Wellstream Inc. is a Dresser Industries company.

Licence holders in Troll B are operator Norsk Hydro (7.69 percent), Statoil (74.58 percent), Shell (8.29 percent), Saga Petroleum (4.08 percent), Elf Petroleum (2.35 percent), Conoco (1.66 percent) and Total (1.35 percent).
